title: Optimistic retry replays SAVEPOINT compensation and preserves rolled-back rowset

payload.p_check: ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT permanently excludes post-savepoint effects from the transaction, including after transparent retry
payload.q_claim: MemDB rollback plus transaction retry history preserve the same final rowset
payload.result: GREEN: the retry history is an ordered event log containing SAVEPOINT, the rolled-back INSERT, ROLLBACK TO, and the surviving INSERT; replay executes the compensating ROLLBACK TO again
payload.natural_reachability: explicit user transaction auto-retry is deprecated and forced off; retryability was enabled only to test the latent composition
payload.stop_rule: do not reopen missing-history-snapshot candidates until the ordered replay log is shown to omit or reorder the compensating control event

name: Replay closure includes compensating control events

payload.contract: A state field omitted from a checkpoint is not a bug when ordered replay includes an equivalent compensating event that dominates final publication.
search_shape: rollback/cancel/undo restores materialized state but does not truncate a replay log
retry/resume rebuilds state by replaying the complete event stream
the compensating control operation may itself be recorded and replayed
mandatory_proof: enumerate the actual replay sequence, not only checkpoint fields
force the retry/resume path and prove trigger evidence
compare final user-visible state with a no-retry control
remove or reorder only the compensating event for a discriminating counterfactual
payload.stop_rule: classify GREEN when the compensating event is replayed in order and the final oracle matches the no-retry control

name: Transparent retry must preserve ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT effects

payload.p_check: row 1 is inserted after SAVEPOINT and removed by ROLLBACK TO; row 2 is inserted afterward
payload.fault: exactly one retryable commit failure with retryability injected
payload.red: commit succeeds and row 1 reappears, or row 2 disappears
payload.observed: commit retried once and final ordered rowset remained only (2,20)

name: Final rowset plus exact replay history trace

invalid_if: only internal history length was asserted

name: Enable explicit retryability and fail exactly one optimistic commit

preserved: real retry plan rebuild and statement execution
payload.build_requirement: run failpoint-ctl enable for pkg/session and pkg/sessiontxn/isolation before go test, then disable it afterward

name: Savepoint compensation under one transparent retry

steps: inject exactly one retryable commit error
assert retry trace and final ordered rowset
payload.control: same schedule without commit error must commit only row 2
payload.counterfactual: omit or move ROLLBACK TO in the replay stream; only then may row 1 resurrection identify the suspected root

lessons.classification: missing checkpoint field is dominated by ordered compensation replay
lessons.method: enumerate effect closure before admitting a state-snapshot omission
